English: Adopt Western Technologies
Spanish: Adoptar Tecnoligias Occidentales

English: We need to modernize the country, the technologies from the West will give us the necessary tools to do it.
Spanish: Necesitamos modernizal el pais, las tecnologias de occidente nos brindaran las herramientas necesarias para hacerlo.

English: Western Techs and Ideas
Spanish: Ideas y Tecnologias Occidentales

English: Contact with the Western powers will allow us to adopt new ideas, knowledge, and technologies. The conquest of the Boer territories will provide us with the necessary incentives to modernize the country.
Spanish: El contacto con las potencias occidentales nos permitira adoptar nuevas ideas, conocimientos y tecnologias. La conquista de los territorios Boer nos proporcionaran los estimulos necesarios para modernizar el pais.

English: Great Zulu
Spanish: Gran Zulu

English: The conquest and unification of the Boer territories of Transvaal and Orange under Zulu rule will allow us to restore the greatness of the Zulu people and claim these territories as a legitimate part of our kingdom. Now our focus is on the South African domain of the United Kingdom, in order to drive out the European invaders.
Spanish: La conquista y unificacion los territorios Boer de Transvaal y Orange bajo el dominio Zulu permitira restaurar la grandeza del pueblo Zulu y reclamar estos territorios como parte legitima de nuestro reino. Ahora nuestro enfoque se dirige al dominio sudafricano del Reino Unido, con el fin de expulsar a los invasores Europeos.

English: Zulu Empire
Spanish: Imperio Zulu

English: After expelling the invaders from our lands, we managed to get all the land in southern Africa, and now, we have to unify under a single flag. Form a powerful nation that unites all the peoples of the region, all the people who were oppressed, an empire that protects all native South Africans, and that ensures that the European invaders do not return. Long live the Zulu Empire!
Spanish: Tras expulsara a los invasores de nuestras tierras, logramos conseguir todos los terrenos del sur de Africa, y ahora, tenemos que unificarnos bajo una sola bandera. Formameros una nacion poderosa que una a todos los pueblos de la region, a todas las personas que fueron oprimidas, un imperio que proteja a todos los nativos Sudafricanos, y que se asegure que no regresen los invasores Europeos. Larga vida al Imperio Zulu!

English: Unite Somalia
Spanish: Unir Somalia

English: After years of wars and the Somali people being divided, we finally managed to bring our people together. We must unite all Somalis under a single, unified flag!
Spanish: Tras tiempos de guerras y que el pueblo Somali estuviera dividido, finalmente logramos juntar a nuestra gente. Debemos unir a todos los Somalies bajo una unica, bandera unificada!

English: Reclaim Our Lands
Spanish: Reclamar Nuestras Tierras

English: After so many years of being separated by the colonizers, we finally managed to reclaim our lands and drive them out, we reunited our people under our flag at last.
Spanish: Despues de tanto tiempo de estar separados por los colonizadores, finalmente logramos recuperar nuestras tierras y expulsarlos, reunimos a nuestra gente bajo nuestra bandera al fin.

English: Expand the Sultanate
Spanish: Expandir el Sultanato

English: After internal discussions, it was concluded that it is necessary to expand into the northern lands, in order to bring the Swahili people together under our glorious banner.
Spanish: Tras debates internos, se llego a la conclusion de que es necesario expandirse por las tierras del norte, para asi poder juntar al pueblo Swahili bajo nuestra gloriosa bandera.
